purpose: S0/S1 nonholdout_training_pilot: native full versus project native+poststepblend full. No local cache, fitting, RL, or net-latency claim.
source_group_isolation: These eight source IDs stay in training/development; new instructions do not create new independent validation sources. Old Dev16 not used; Test64 sealed.

pipeline_contract.acceleration_lora: original Qwen-Image-Edit matching8step Lightning LoRA; exact revision/fileSHA to freeze in runtime protocol
pipeline_contract.mask_fusion: After scheduler step, M_allow keeps predicted target latent, complement replaced by source VAE latent at next sigma using fixed same epsilon; final source region sigma0. Actual code/scheduler/layout must be audited before run.
pipeline_contract.image_inputs: One complete source image; masks are control tensors, not extra reference-image token sequences.

planned_budget.failure_retry_warmup_extra_accounting: All actual calls counted separately; nominal8steps must be confirmed by hooks.

mask_coordinate_contract.M_allow_rule: Dilate M_user rectangle16sourcepixels each side then clip to source canvas. Frozen before new output.
mask_coordinate_contract.target_mask_resize: nearest and explicit binary; no crop/pad; runtime must record actual processor and packed layout
mask_coordinate_contract.core_coverage_requirement: C_t contains every actual processed/packed mask location with m>0. Runtime actual counts may differ from geometric estimates; do not assert estimate equality.

proposal_seed_superseded: Per-source seeds in proposal are superseded by shared historical seed2026102201 and explicit epsilon contract in this JSON.
